title: Fix Redis pipeline error handling in artifacts and job store
description:
**Bug**: Multiple locations use `_, _ = pipe.Exec(ctx)` ignoring pipeline errors:
- `core/infra/artifacts/redis_store.go:114`
- `core/infra/memory/job_store.go:382, 1263`
- `core/infra/memory/dlq_store.go:90, 136`

**Fix**: Check pipeline exec errors and propagate or log them.

**Files**: `core/infra/artifacts/redis_store.go`, `core/infra/memory/job_store.go`, `core/infra/memory/dlq_store.go`
definitionOfDone: All pipe.Exec() calls check and handle errors
No silent _ = pipe.Exec() remains in these files

implementationPlan.description:
Replace `_, _ = pipe.Exec(ctx)` with logged error checks in all 5 locations. These are all read-pipeline patterns where individual command results are checked after exec, so partial results are acceptable but errors should be visible:

```go
if _, err := pipe.Exec(ctx); err != nil && err != redis.Nil {
    slog.Warn("redis pipeline exec", "op", "<operation>", "error", err)
}
```

Locations:
- `core/infra/artifacts/redis_store.go:114` — op: "get_artifact"
- `core/infra/memory/job_store.go:382` — op: "build_job_records"
- `core/infra/memory/job_store.go:1263` — op: "get_trace_jobs"
- `core/infra/memory/dlq_store.go:90` — op: "list_dlq"
- `core/infra/memory/dlq_store.go:136` — op: "list_dlq_by_score"
Run `go test ./core/infra/...` to verify no regressions.
